lead.headline: Kincaid is out. Big Stric’s tight end spot is empty.
lead.dek: Overnight Dalton Kincaid went from Doubtful to Out, and Big Stric Energy has no tight end on the bench. It now projects 142.63 to the champ’s 158.37 and is a 34.6% underdog in the game that decides who stays alive.
lead.pull: The 2-8 bowl has a clock now, and only one of these front offices is racing it.
body: Last call, 8:48 AM. One thing in this league changed overnight, and it landed on the team that could least afford it. Big Stric Energy’s tight end, Dalton Kincaid, is now Out with the thumb. Tucker Kraft is on bye. The bench has Saquon Barkley, DK Metcalf and nobody who plays tight end. This is no longer a game-time decision. It’s a waiver claim.

The wire has answers, and none of them are glamorous. Darren Waller projects 8.78 and is free. Dawson Knox is the most-added tight end in football this week and projects 5.84. Either one beats the 0.0 sitting in that slot right now. My call: Waller, and do it before his game kicks off, not after.

Here’s why it matters. Fill the hole and make the Barkley swap (12.69 over Braelon Allen’s 9.1) and Big Stric’s best is 143.99. The champ, Maye I touch your TDs?, projects 158.37 without touching a thing. Emmett Johnson (19.6), Amon-Ra St. Brown (19.33) and Bucky Irving (18.39) are all still in the building. Big Stric has 14.8 from Nico Collins in the bank and 10 players left. The champ has 11 left and hasn’t scored yet.

The champ has one call of its own, same as yesterday: Matt Gay is still Questionable with a hip, still one of the most-dropped players in football, and still the kicker. Chase McLaughlin (6.68) is free and projects above Gay (6.48). In a game the champ leads as projected, it’s a small call. In the playoff race, small calls are the only ones left.

The stakes haven’t moved: Santa Clara’s Finest hold the last spot at 57.1%. The champ is at 25.2%. Big Stric is at 17.7%. My pick: the champ, and more comfortably than this morning’s column would have said. Big Stric’s path is Josh Allen and Justin Jefferson going off, and a tight end showing up from the wire.

quick_hits.headline: Poochinski’s 10:00 AM call decides the favorite
quick_hits.body: As set, Poochinski projects 153.47 and Santa Clara’s Finest project 159.34. Swap Luther Burden III (15.09) in for Jadarian Price, who is on bye, and Caleb Williams (20.04) in for Aaron Rodgers (16.57), and Poochinski’s best is 172.03 and a 63.2% favorite. Burden’s deadline is Sun 10:00 AM, the first one on the board. The Seattle Seahawks D/ST is still on bye; the Detroit Lions D/ST (6.58) is still free.

quick_hits.headline: Bowers projects 0.0. Coleman is the answer.
quick_hits.body: Brock Bowers is still Questionable with the ankle, and his projection has dropped to 0.0. Jonah Coleman (17.21) is on the bench, and Bo Nix (17.88) sits behind Jared Goff (17.24). Cherry Blossom as set is 144.92; at its best it’s 162.77 and 62.7% against Bad things man bad things. Deadline Sun 1:25 PM.

quick_hits.headline: AB81: four byes and a 1:25 PM deadline
quick_hits.body: Matthew Stafford, Kyren Williams, Jaxon Smith-Njigba and Rhamondre Stevenson are all on bye in AB81’s lineup. Mike Evans (13.81, Questionable), DeVonta Smith (13.6) and George Kittle (12.4) are the bench answers. As set it’s 69.76; filled, 109.57 and an 11.1% shot. The second quarterback still has to come off the wire.

quick_hits.headline: Two kickers needed. McLaughlin and Santos are free.
quick_hits.body: deeboliciouskins still lists Jason Myers, on bye, and is 88.9% to win anyway with 9.9 already banked. The champ still lists Matt Gay, Questionable. Chase McLaughlin (6.68) and Cairo Santos (6.47) are both on the wire. One each.

quick_hits.headline: Two teams are set and waiting
quick_hits.body: Santa Clara’s Finest (16.0 banked, 159.34 as set) and Bad things man bad things (21.46 banked from C.J. Stroud, 149.1 as set) have nothing left to decide. They’re 36.8% and 37.3%. Both lead on the scoreboard. Both need the other front office to leave something on the table.

w11-r1-s6.headline: Big Stric’s tight end: Waller or Knox?
w11-r1-s6.blurb: Dalton Kincaid is Out, Tucker Kraft is on bye, and there’s no tight end on the bench. Darren Waller (8.78) is free. Dawson Knox (5.84) is the most-added tight end in football. I’d take Waller.
